payload.body_you: Saturn in Aries can make leaving look like the cleanest answer. Sometimes moving is necessary. But a new address cannot change the role you keep accepting, the family member you never say no to, or the way every household responsibility somehow becomes yours. Before you move, name what will actually be different when you arrive.
payload.body_they: Saturn in Aries can make leaving look like the cleanest answer to them. Sometimes moving is necessary, but a new address cannot change the role they keep accepting, the family member they never say no to, or the way every household responsibility somehow becomes theirs. A move only helps when something besides the address will be different when they arrive.

ownerConfirmationStatement: the writing that was being shown in the natal chart was approved
